purpose: Freeze source-audit, provenance, unit, cosmology, transformation, leakage, and observation-opening rules before an independent cluster target is selected or opened.

metadata_sources.audited_fact: CHEX-MATE contains 118 XMM-Newton clusters; the cited temperature pipeline paper demonstrates the method on a representative 30-cluster subset.
ESA exposes the XMM-Newton observation collection and bibliographic associations; this does not by itself establish a complete derived-profile or covariance release.
The paper analyzes a 50-cluster high-luminosity LoCuSS sample with Chandra and XMM-Newton and reports extracted surface-brightness and temperature profiles.
HEASARC exposes the 239-cluster ACCEPT Chandra entropy-profile catalog and identifies the public project data; it is not an SZ pressure release.
NASA LAMBDA exposes ACT maps and supporting products, but map availability is not an object-level deprojected pressure profile with all required predictors.
NASA LAMBDA exposes SPT maps, noise spectra, bandpasses, transfer functions, beams, masks, and catalogs; an independent object-level profile extraction remains required.

CHEX-MATE A&A 704 A302 presents XMM-Newton and Planck pressure profiles for 28 DR1 clusters and a 24-cluster subset with dynamical-mass estimates; it propagates Planck pressure covariance but uses a non-public MILCA all-sky y-map and does not establish a public file-level release containing every CP3 predictor, response, calibration, and covariance role.

The ACT DR6 v3 catalog reports 10,040 SZ-selected cluster candidates, including a 3,758-object Legacy sample, and documents public catalog products; catalog observables and mass proxies are not direct radial thermodynamic profiles.

NASA LAMBDA exposes the ACT DR6 v1.0 cluster catalog, masks, eRASS1 crossmatch flags, and forced-photometry documentation; these products do not form an object-level density, stellar-baryon, SZ-pressure, and X-ray-temperature packet.

NASA LAMBDA exposes ACT DR6.02 maps, inverse-variance maps, null splits, beams, and bandpass products; map-level noise and calibration assets are inputs to a prospective reduction, not verified deprojected object-pressure profiles or complete cross-instrument covariance.

The official eROSITA DR1 catalog page exposes the 12,247-object eRASS1 primary cluster catalog and data model; it does not expose a joined CP3 packet of resolved gas-density, stellar-baryon, SZ-pressure, and spectroscopic-temperature profiles with full covariance.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 118 Planck-selected CHEX-MATE clusters; published temperature-method demonstration on 30

observed_availability: A 118-object CHEX-MATE inventory, a published 30-object temperature-method demonstration, and the official XMM-Newton observation collection are publicly documented.
No single official release was verified to expose the complete density, stellar-baryon, SZ-pressure, temperature, calibration, and covariance packet required by CP3.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: The full 118-object program is below the frozen 120-object minimum and 192-object target before availability, quality, and overlap cuts; the demonstrated 30-object subset is smaller still.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Article and observation-archive availability does not bind reuse terms to every required derived profile, calibration, and covariance file.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: Object aliases have not been reconciled against X-COP, so the untouched independent population is unknown.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: No complete public within-profile and cross-instrument covariance bundle for all required density, temperature, and pressure channels has been verified.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 50 high-X-ray-luminosity clusters at approximately 0.15 to 0.30 redshift
candidate_lanes.instrument_family: Chandra and XMM-Newton; Subaru weak lensing is not an allowed thermodynamic target

observed_availability: A published 50-cluster Chandra/XMM-Newton analysis documents surface-brightness and temperature work.
No official complete CP3 file packet for this lane was verified.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: The 50-object parent sample is below both the frozen 120-object minimum and 192-object target before quality and overlap cuts.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Publication access does not establish per-file reuse terms for every required profile, calibration asset, and covariance product.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: Aliases and sample membership have not been audited against X-COP.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: A complete released covariance across radius, X-ray instruments, and the required pressure channel has not been verified.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 239-cluster archival ACCEPT catalog subject to overlap and selection audits

observed_availability: HEASARC publicly exposes the 239-cluster ACCEPT entropy-profile catalog, including density and temperature information.
ACCEPT is not an SZ-pressure or stellar-baryon release.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: The 239-object parent inventory exceeds 192, but the eligible joined population after pressure, stellar-baryon, quality, licensing, and overlap requirements is unknown and cannot be treated as powered.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Per-file reuse terms for a future joined multi-archive packet have not been bound.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: The archival sample has not been de-duplicated against X-COP or the other prospective confirmation sources.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: The catalog does not supply a verified complete joint radial covariance for density, temperature, pressure, and cross-calibration nuisances.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: public ACT or SPT map footprints and cluster catalogs; object set not selected

observed_availability: NASA LAMBDA exposes ACT and SPT maps, catalogs, beams, masks, noise, transfer-function, and bandpass assets.
Map availability does not establish object-level deprojected pressure profiles or the X-ray and stellar-baryon channels.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: No object set or joined eligible population is selected, so neither the 120-object minimum nor 192-object target can be claimed.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Public map access has not been converted into per-file reuse bindings for a derived multi-survey profile packet.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: No object-level lane exists yet to audit against X-COP.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: Map noise products are not a verified complete object-profile covariance across radius, deprojection, calibration, foreground, and X-ray channels.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: 28 CHEX-MATE DR1 clusters with XMM-Newton and Planck pressure profiles in A&A 704 A302; 24 have dynamical-mass estimates for the joint mass fit

observed_availability: CHEX-MATE A&A 704 A302 documents XMM-Newton and Planck pressure profiles for 28 DR1 clusters; its joint mass-fit subset contains the 24 clusters with dynamical-mass estimates.
The Planck reduction propagates correlated Compton-y noise into pressure covariance matrices, but it starts from a non-public MILCA all-sky y-map.
The primary article is public, but no official all-fields file bundle satisfying the frozen source manifest was verified.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: The 28-cluster pressure sample and its 24-cluster dynamical-mass subset are below the frozen 120-object minimum and 192-object target, even before availability, quality, and overlap exclusions; neither can be the powered primary confirmation sample.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: The article license does not establish per-file reuse terms for every underlying or derived profile, calibration product, and covariance file.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: The 28 pressure-sample aliases have not been audited against X-COP, so independent membership is unverified.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: The paper documents Planck pressure-covariance propagation, but the underlying MILCA y-map is non-public and no released complete density-temperature-pressure and cross-instrument covariance packet was verified.

candidate_lanes.sample_scope: ACT DR6 contains 10,040 SZ candidates and eRASS1 contains 12,247 primary catalog clusters; the joined resolved-profile eligible population is not yet defined
candidate_lanes.instrument_family: ACT DR6 millimeter maps plus eROSITA eRASS1 X-ray catalogs and a prospective profile reduction

observed_availability: Official ACT DR6 releases expose a 10,040-candidate catalog, masks, eRASS1 crossmatch flags, maps, inverse-variance products, null splits, beams, and bandpasses.
The official eRASS1 release exposes a 12,247-object primary cluster catalog and sky-survey data model.
These public assets define a prospective target-blind reduction route; they do not constitute a ready joined radial-profile packet.
audit_details.population_and_power_limitations: Large parent catalogs do not establish a powered sample: the eligible count after resolved X-ray spectroscopy, radial SZ deprojection, stellar-baryon coverage, quality, licensing, and X-COP exclusion is unknown and cannot be compared with the 120-object minimum or 192-object target.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: Public access is not yet bound to per-file reuse and derived-product terms for every ACT, eROSITA, optical/stellar, calibration, and covariance input.
audit_details.overlap_blocker: The prospective joined population and its object aliases have not been frozen or audited against X-COP.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: ACT inverse-variance and null products are not a complete object-profile covariance, and no joined covariance across SZ deprojection, eROSITA radial density/temperature, stellar baryons, calibration, and cross-instrument systematics is verified.

unit_and_constant_freeze.source_native_scaled_profile_rule: Store the released dimensionless value, released scale, released physical value, and source cosmology separately; never silently substitute a new R500, P500, or T500.
unit_and_constant_freeze.uncertainty_rule: Every deterministic unit conversion applies to samples or the complete covariance, not only to central values.

cosmology_and_redshift_freeze.angular_to_physical_rule: r_kpc=theta_radian*D_A_kpc(z) using the frozen reference cosmology; compare against source-native radii and carry the difference as a cosmology sensitivity.
